answer: Use a verifiable-delay proof tied to one hardware-backed key per agent. First, each agent creates a key inside its secure enclave and publishes it once. Second, it must solve a sequential delay puzzle taking 20 minutes per identity, work that cannot be parallelized. Third, peers verify the proof in 2 seconds and reject any reused puzzle. Forging 10,000 fakes then needs 10,000 enclaves, $2,400,000 in hardware, and 139 days of sequential work, while agents pay once. A hollow claim becomes a canyon copies cannot cross, and the honest grove grows only from roots that took time to plant.
